_schema.platform: Trait Transfer & Genome Editing Intelligence Platform

Level 1.label: Commercially Validated
Level 1.desc: Verified in commercial cultivars or released products.

Level 3.label: Genetic Association
Level 3.desc: Supported by QTL, GWAS, linkage mapping, or natural allelic variation.

Level 4.label: Candidate Gene
Level 4.desc: Inferred via orthology, expression profiling, or pathway homology.

Level 5.label: Hypothesis / Research Gap
Level 5.desc: Exploratory polygenic or multi-stress target requiring functional validation.

portability_tiers.t1: Native Edit (NGT Cat-1 candidate — crop's own gene/promoter)
portability_tiers.t2: Cisgenic / Introgression (Crossable wild relative — check linkage drag)
portability_tiers.t3: Transgenic / De Novo (Outside primary gene pool)

entries.gene_function: Glutamate decarboxylase; C-terminal autoinhibitory calmodulin-binding domain (CaMBD) regulates GABA synthesis.
entries.editing_possibility: CRISPR-Cas9 premature stop codon in CaMBD
entries.conventional_breeding: Limited natural variation in elite lines
entries.evidence_note: Commercially validated (Sicilian Rouge High GABA). 2025 studies across 3 elite backgrounds confirm genotype-dependent vegetative side effects.
entries.pleiotropic_effects: High GABA levels in certain elite backgrounds can reduce leaf size or fruit weight; cultivar-specific testing required.
entries.scientific_reference: Nonaka et al., 2017 (Sci. Rep.); 2025 Elite Genotype Evaluation
entries.patent_reference: Sanatech Seed / Tsukuba Univ. patents (check FTO)

entries.gene_function: 7-dehydrocholesterol reductase isoform converting 7-DHC to cholesterol in the phytosterol/glycoalkaloid pathway.
entries.evidence_note: Functionally validated in greenhouse/field trials; requires UVB exposure to convert 7-DHC into Vitamin D3.
entries.pleiotropic_effects: Alters steroidal glycoalkaloid (alpha-tomatine) profile; no major yield penalty reported.
entries.environmental_interaction: Requires UVB light exposure for active D3 conversion
entries.scientific_reference: Li et al., 2022, Nature Plants

entries.gene_function: Host membrane proteins required for tobamovirus replication complex assembly.
entries.conventional_breeding: Tm-2^2 broken by ToBRFV; wild Solanum QTLs carry heavy linkage drag
entries.evidence_note: Experimental proof only. Confers strong resistance to tested ToBRFV isolates, NOT guaranteed universal immunity across all tobamoviruses/isolates.
entries.linkage_drag: Avoids severe linkage drag associated with S. habrochaites / S. pimpinellifolium introgressions.
entries.pleiotropic_effects: Single knockouts insufficient due to redundancy; triple/quadruple knockouts must be screened for vigor.
entries.environmental_interaction: High temperature can challenge viral resistance durability
entries.scientific_reference: Ishikawa et al., 2022; Kravchik et al., 2022

entries.gene_function: Messenger RNA surveillance factor Pelota involved in ribosome recycling.
entries.gene_action: Loss of function / Recessive natural allele
entries.evidence_note: Commercially deployed via natural ty-5 allele and validated via CRISPR knockout.
entries.linkage_drag: None when edited directly in elite line.
entries.pleiotropic_effects: Minimal; well-tolerated across commercial indeterminate and determinate hybrids.
entries.scientific_reference: Lapidot et al., 2015; Pramanik et al., 2021
entries.patent_reference: Publicly documented locus; check specific CRISPR claims

entries.gene_function: Susceptibility (S) gene encoding a seven-transmembrane protein required for fungal penetration.
entries.editing_possibility: CRISPR-Cas9 deletion (e.g., 48-bp deletion mimicking natural ol-2)
entries.evidence_note: Functionally validated transgene-free 'Tomelo' lines; durable broad-spectrum powdery mildew resistance.
entries.linkage_drag: Eliminates backcross drag from wild donor lines.
entries.pleiotropic_effects: Minor necrotic flecking under certain stress conditions in some MLO orthologs.
entries.environmental_interaction: Humidity and light intensity can modulate minor leaf flecking
entries.scientific_reference: Nekrasov et al., 2017, Sci. Rep.
entries.patent_reference: Check S-gene / MLO editing patent families

entries.trait: Multi-pathogen resistance (Bacterial speck, Phytophthora, Powdery mildew)
entries.gene_function: 2-oxoglutarate Fe(II)-dependent oxygenase that hydroxylates and inactivates salicylic acid (SA).
entries.evidence_note: Functionally validated; elevates basal salicylic acid levels conferring broad resistance.
entries.pleiotropic_effects: Potential growth/yield trade-off under high pathogen-free vigor conditions if SA is overly elevated.
entries.environmental_interaction: Evaluate yield penalty under non-stressed commercial trials
entries.scientific_reference: Thomazella et al., 2021, PNAS

entries.trait: Compact / dwarf architecture for vertical farming & early harvest
entries.gene_function: ERECTA receptor kinase (internode length) and florigen/antiflorigen photoperiod regulators.
entries.evidence_note: Strong functional validation for urban/vertical farming rapid-cycling compact tomatoes.
entries.pleiotropic_effects: Reduces total per-plant biomass; increases yield per unit area/time in high-density systems.
entries.scientific_reference: Kwon et al., 2020, Nat. Biotechnol.

entries.trait: Parthenocarpy (seedless fruit set — distinct from heat tolerance)
entries.gene_function: Auxin signaling repressor (SlIAA9) and MADS-box ovule regulator (SlAGL6).
entries.recommended_strategy: CRISPR-Cas9 (SlAGL6 preferred for fewer leaf pleiotropies)
entries.evidence_note: Scientific note: Parthenocarpy enables fruit set without fertilization, but does NOT automatically equate to whole-plant heat tolerance.
entries.pleiotropic_effects: SlIAA9 knockout alters leaf morphology (simple leaves); SlAGL6 avoids leaf distortion.
entries.environmental_interaction: Maintains fruit set under suboptimal pollination temperatures
entries.scientific_reference: Ueta et al., 2017; Klap et al., 2017

entries.gene_function: Cell number regulator (FW2.2) and PPD-KIX repressor complex limiting cell division.
entries.editing_possibility: CRISPR-Cas9 double knockout (SlKIX8 + SlKIX9) or promoter editing
entries.evidence_note: SlKIX8/SlKIX9 double mutants show enlarged fruits with thicker pericarp.
entries.pleiotropic_effects: Enlarged cup-shaped leaves; potential trade-off between fruit size and fruit number.
entries.scientific_reference: Swinnen et al., 2022, Plant Physiol.

entries.trait: Fruit firmness & extended shelf life without ripening block
entries.gene_function: Pectate lyase and cell-wall-modifying enzymes degrading middle lamella pectin.
entries.editing_possibility: CRISPR-Cas9 knockout (SlPL alone or stacked with SlPG2a)
entries.conventional_breeding: rin/nor alleles cause severe flavor/color loss; SlPL avoids this
entries.evidence_note: Functionally validated; increases firmness and reduces postharvest rot without sacrificing lycopene or Brix.
entries.pleiotropic_effects: Unusually clean profile; slightly reduced susceptibility to gray mold.
entries.scientific_reference: Uluisik et al., 2016, Nat. Biotechnol.; Wang et al., 2019

entries.gene_function: Putative acyltransferase catalyzing the final condensation step of capsaicinoid biosynthesis.
entries.editing_possibility: CRISPR-Cas9 knockout to convert hot elite lines to sweet bell/snack types
entries.evidence_note: Commercially established locus; distinct biochemical step from pAMT.
entries.linkage_drag: Native edit avoids fruit-shape drag when converting hot lines to sweet.
entries.pleiotropic_effects: Loss of capsaicin may increase susceptibility to certain fungal/insect pests.
entries.environmental_interaction: Pungency intensity modulated by water/heat stress
entries.scientific_reference: Stewart et al., 2005, Plant J.

entries.gene_function: Putative aminotransferase converting vanillin to vanillylamine in capsaicinoid pathway.
entries.evidence_note: Distinct target from Pun1; loss-of-function redirects flux toward non-pungent capsinoids.
entries.pleiotropic_effects: Alters aroma/volatile profile.
entries.scientific_reference: Lang et al., 2009, Plant J.

entries.trait: Potyvirus resistance (PVY, TEV, PepMoV — pvr1 / pvr2)
entries.gene_function: Eukaryotic translation initiation factor interacting with viral VPg protein.
entries.gene_action: Loss of function or specific amino acid substitution (Base Editing)
entries.editing_possibility: Base Editing (mimicking natural pvr1 alleles) or Knockout
entries.evidence_note: Commercially validated; base editing avoids pleiotropic defects of full eIF4E + eIFiso4E loss.
entries.pleiotropic_effects: Simultaneous knockout of both eIF4E1 and eIFiso4E impairs plant growth; single allele point edits are safe.
entries.scientific_reference: Ruffel et al., 2002; Yoon et al., 2020

entries.gene_function: Clade V MLO susceptibility factor.
entries.conventional_breeding: QTL introgression from C. baccatum / C. chinense
entries.evidence_note: Scientific caution: Not every MLO knockout confers resistance; Clade V paralog specificity must be verified.
entries.pleiotropic_effects: Check for premature leaf senescence.
entries.scientific_reference: Zheng et al., 2013; Kim & Hwang, 2012

entries.trait: Non-bitter fruit while retaining bitter-leaf defense
entries.gene_function: Bi encodes cucurbitadienol synthase (core pathway); Bl regulates leaf bitterness; Bt regulates fruit bitterness.
entries.gene_action: Loss of function of Bt specifically
entries.editing_possibility: CRISPR-Cas9 targeted edit of Bt (preserving Bl)
entries.evidence_note: Model case of tissue-specific regulation: knocking out Bt removes fruit bitterness without stripping leaf herbivore defense (Bl).
entries.pleiotropic_effects: Knocking out Bi eliminates all cucurbitacins (reduces pest deterrence); target Bt instead.
entries.environmental_interaction: Prevents stress-induced fruit bitterness under heat/drought
entries.scientific_reference: Shang et al., 2014, Science

entries.gene_function: Clade V MLO susceptibility genes.
entries.evidence_note: Functionally validated; paralog selection (Clade V) is critical.
entries.linkage_drag: Eliminates linkage drag with fruit-skin netting/yellowing QTLs.
entries.pleiotropic_effects: Possible minor leaf chlorosis in older leaves.
entries.scientific_reference: Berg et al., 2015, Front. Plant Sci.

entries.trait: Gynoecy & parthenocarpy (Female flower dominance & seedless fruit)
entries.gene_function: Ethylene biosynthesis (ACS) and zinc-finger carpel arrest suppressor (CsWIP1).
entries.gene_action: Loss of function of CsWIP1 -> gynoecious phenotype
entries.evidence_note: Functionally validated in cucumber and melon; enables rapid F1 hybrid seed production.
entries.pleiotropic_effects: Requires silver thiosulfate / gibberellin induction for male flower maintenance in seed production.
entries.environmental_interaction: Photoperiod and temperature interact with sex expression
entries.scientific_reference: Hu et al., 2017, Plant J.

entries.trait: Extended shelf life & climacteric ripening control
entries.gene_function: ACC oxidase catalyzing final step of ethylene biosynthesis.
entries.editing_possibility: CRISPR-Cas9 knockout or Promoter Editing (for partial ethylene reduction)
entries.recommended_strategy: Promoter Editing (preserves aroma volatiles better than full knockout)
entries.evidence_note: Functionally validated; full ethylene block reduces ester aroma (CmAAT1), so fine-tuning expression is ideal.
entries.pleiotropic_effects: Complete ethylene loss reduces volatile aroma synthesis.
entries.scientific_reference: Nonaka et al., 2023; Ayub et al., 1996

entries.gene_function: D-class MADS-box transcription factor governing ovule integument and seed coat development.
entries.gene_action: Loss of function / Tissue-specific promoter edit
entries.conventional_breeding: Triploid (3x = 2x × 4x) hybrid system remains the commercial standard
entries.evidence_note: Scientific caveat: Research target ONLY. Has NOT commercially replaced standard triploid seedless watermelon production due to fruit-set/size penalties.
entries.pleiotropic_effects: Full ClAGL11 knockout often reduces fruit size, hollow heart incidence, and pollination efficiency.
entries.scientific_reference: Wang et al., 2021; Cucurbit AGL11 studies

entries.gene_function: Tonoplast sugar transporter (ClTST2) and lycopene beta-cyclase (ClLCYB).
entries.gene_action: Gain of function (ClTST2) / Loss of function (ClLCYB for red flesh)
entries.evidence_note: Functionally validated; ClTST2 promoter variation drives vacuolar sugar loading.
entries.pleiotropic_effects: Minimal in cultivated backgrounds.
entries.scientific_reference: Ren et al., 2018, Plant Cell; Guo et al., 2019
entries.patent_reference: Beijing Academy of Agriculture & Forestry Sciences

entries.gene_function: Polyphenol oxidases catalyzing oxidation of chlorogenic acid into brown quinones upon cutting.
entries.editing_possibility: Multiplex CRISPR-Cas9 knockout of fruit-expressed PPOs
entries.evidence_note: Functionally validated; reduces post-cut enzymatic browning while preserving phenolic antioxidant content.
entries.pleiotropic_effects: No significant yield penalty observed in greenhouse trials.
entries.scientific_reference: Maioli et al., 2020, Front. Plant Sci.

entries.gene_function: Transcriptional regulators of epidermal prickle initiation.
entries.evidence_note: Scientific distinction: SmMYB candidates are under investigation; should NOT be presented as a single-gene proven CRISPR solution.
entries.linkage_drag: Classical prickle-free donors sometimes carry calyx size differences.
entries.pleiotropic_effects: Trichome/prickle pathways can overlap with insect deterrence.
entries.scientific_reference: Miyatake et al., 2020; Solanaceae prickle genetics

entries.trait: Delayed bolting (premature flowering under summer heat)
entries.gene_function: Florigen (LsFT) and photoperiodic flowering integrators.
entries.gene_action: Loss of function / Hypomorphic promoter edit
entries.editing_possibility: CRISPR-Cas9 knockout or promoter editing of LsFT
entries.evidence_note: Functionally validated; strong interaction between genotype, temperature, and photoperiod must be accounted for.
entries.pleiotropic_effects: Full knockout delays seed production in seed-increase fields (requires GA3 application for seed harvest).
entries.environmental_interaction: High G×E with temperature and day length
entries.scientific_reference: Chen et al., 2018, Plant Biotechnol. J.

entries.trait: Elevated Vitamin C (Ascorbate) via uORF editing
entries.gene_function: GDP-L-galactose phosphorylase; upstream ORF (uORF) represses translation.
entries.gene_action: Gain of translation (CRISPR disruption of inhibitory uORF)
entries.evidence_note: Scientific precision: 2–3× increase reported specifically via uORF editing of LsGGP2, not a generic CRISPR effect.
entries.pleiotropic_effects: Enhanced oxidative stress tolerance; minimal growth trade-off.
entries.scientific_reference: Zhang et al., 2018, Nat. Biotechnol.

entries.gene_function: TIR-NBS-LRR (TNL) immune receptor loci.
entries.editing_possibility: Cisgenic transfer or Prime Editing of R-gene alleles
entries.evidence_note: Commercially critical, but CR loci are pathotype-specific—NOT universal resistance. Single-gene cultivars break down rapidly.
entries.linkage_drag: Moderate when transferring from B. rapa into B. oleracea.
entries.pleiotropic_effects: Minimal.
entries.environmental_interaction: Soil pH and P. brassicae pathotype virulence
entries.scientific_reference: Ueno et al., 2012; Hatakeyama et al., 2013

entries.gene_function: R2R3-MYB transcription factors activating aliphatic glucosinolate biosynthesis.
entries.gene_action: Gain of function / Wild B. villosa allele introgression
entries.evidence_note: Commercially validated in high-glucoraphanin broccoli hybrids.
entries.linkage_drag: Reduced via fine-mapped B. villosa introgression.
entries.pleiotropic_effects: High glucosinolate levels alter flavor pungency and insect feeding.
entries.scientific_reference: Traka et al., 2013, New Phytol.

entries.gene_function: DcRPGE1 interacts with DcAPRR2 to regulate chromoplast biogenesis and carotenoid accumulation.
entries.evidence_note: 2024 functional validation demonstrated the DcRPGE1–DcAPRR2 regulatory module in carrot taproot pigmentation.
entries.pleiotropic_effects: Affects plastid differentiation in taproot phloem/xylem.
entries.scientific_reference: 2024 Functional Carrot Root Color Study; Ellison et al., 2018

entries.gene_function: Lachrymatory factor synthase (AcLFS) converts 1-propenyl sulfenic acid into tear-inducing propanethial S-oxide.
entries.editing_possibility: CRISPR-Cas9 / RNAi (challenging due to large ~16 Gb genome & multi-copy LFS)
entries.recommended_strategy: Conventional Breeding / Genomic Selection (due to complex polygenic/multi-copy architecture)
entries.evidence_note: Commercially validated (tearless onions), but NOT a simple single-gene knockout due to multi-copy LFS genes and sulfur pathway interactions.
entries.linkage_drag: Low-pungency often correlates with shorter storage dormancy; requires careful multi-trait selection.
entries.pleiotropic_effects: Redirects sulfur flux toward thiosulfinates (sweetness) while potentially lowering storage life.
entries.environmental_interaction: Soil sulfur availability strongly affects pungency
entries.scientific_reference: Eady et al., 2008, Plant Physiol.

entries.trait: Combined Heat + Salinity + Drought Tolerance (Mediterranean field conditions)
entries.gene_function: Coordinated ion homeostasis, osmoprotection, and heat-shock chaperone networks.
entries.gene_action: Inducible promoter tuning + Polygenic allele stacking
entries.editing_possibility: Stress-inducible promoter editing (constitutive overexpression causes severe yield drag)
entries.evidence_note: Critical Research Gap: Single-stress lab screens fail to predict combined heat + salinity performance in the field.
entries.linkage_drag: High in wild relative crosses; requires fine-mapping.
entries.pleiotropic_effects: Constitutive DREB/SOS activation stunts growth.
entries.environmental_interaction: High VPD, elevated root-zone EC, and heat waves
entries.scientific_reference: Zandalinas et al., 2021; Rivero et al., 2022

entries.trait: Pollen & ovule thermotolerance + stigma receptivity under heat waves
entries.gene: HsfA2, HSP70, ROS scavengers (APX), MADS-box regulators
entries.gene_function: Protects tapetum development, pollen germination, and ovule viability at >35°C.
entries.conventional_breeding: Phenotyping pollen viability under heat stress + Genomic Selection
entries.evidence_note: High-value breeding frontier: Vegetative heat tolerance does not guarantee reproductive fertility.
entries.pleiotropic_effects: Must avoid altering normal floral organ identity.
entries.tissue: Anther tapetum, pollen grain, stigma, ovule
entries.environmental_interaction: Nighttime high temperatures are particularly damaging
entries.scientific_reference: Rieu et al., 2017; Fragkostefanakis et al., 2016

entries.gene: WOX, PLT (PLETHORA), LBD, DRO1, ABA catabolism (CYP707A)
entries.gene_function: Root meristem regeneration and rapid ABA clearance upon stress relief.
entries.evidence_note: Next-generation decision metric: Speed of yield recovery after transient heat/drought/salinity episodes.
entries.pleiotropic_effects: Over-rapid ABA degradation risks vulnerability to recurring stress.
entries.tissue: Root apical meristem & lateral root primordia
entries.environmental_interaction: Cyclic irrigation and intermittent heat stress
entries.scientific_reference: 2025–2026 Plant Resilience Frameworks
